body: The battery and field radio share yellow dust from the greenhouse trial. They were bundled before the phones went dead.
title: Battery and field radio, sunday after supper
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same yellow dust while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body: The map is creased at the junction and tied with string. One destination has been erased so deeply that the paper nearly split; the route leading to it remains clear.
title: A route folded into a pocket
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
